text: Where should the connectors be positioned on the Main and Sensor boards?

speaker: freelancer
text: Can you provide the connector locations for both the Main board and the Sensor board?

speaker: client
text: Because the main and sensor boards slide vertically into the enclosure rails, each is mounted with its long edge at the top. Put the high-pin-count main connectors along that long top edge on both boards, with none on either side or the bottom. On the main board, J\_SENSOR\_PWR and J\_SENSOR\_SIG must line up with J\_SENSOR\_PWR and J\_SENSOR\_SIG on the sensor board at the same relative locations along the top edge; this keeps the inter-board cables short and lets them run straight between the boards.

speaker: client
text: As shown in the image I sent earlier, that side will face down and be hard to access, so put as few components as possible on the bottom.

speaker: client
text: Since this is a prototype, the dimensions and similar details can change. In the layout, the small sensor board is on the left, the main board is in the middle, and the power board is on the right. The important point is that they stand vertically: cables will be easier to connect from the top, while smaller connectors can go on the sides.
